exposure: Uterine Artery Embolization (UAE) followed by curettage
cohort: 205 patients diagnosed with uterine scar pregnancy (USP) who received curettage.
finding: Lauromacrogol-based sclerotherapy followed by curettage significantly reduced bleeding, pain, hospital days, and medical costs compared to UAE-based curettage, with no significant difference in menstruation recovery or HCG reduction.
